## Functional annotation swab samples svamp RVVC project

This script analyzes and visualizes the data generated by HUMAnN3 and MetaPhlAn functional pathway annotation of vaginal swab samples part of the svamp RVVC project. By shotgun sequencing all DNA present in a sample was broken in pieces and individually sequenced, followed by assembly of broken pices based on overlapping sequences to construct the DNA sequence. In the analysis pipeline host reads are removed and quality control is performed. The microbial reads are mapped to the MetaCyc database to determine what the detected gene's function is. The aim is to investigate the difference in functional profiles between patient groups: RVVCpos, RVVCneg, AS and Control. Also, how the clinical score as a measure of clinical severity and two distinct transcriptomic based clusters of RVVCpos samples influence the vaginal microbiome is further investigated.

Cross sectional groups were defined by culture and self-reported symptom score:

-   RVVCpos: positive culture for C. albicans, symptom score \>= 1, \> 2 episodes RVVC per year, now known as RVVCcul.pos

-   RVVCneg: negative culture, \> 2 episodes RVVC per year, now known as RVVCcul.neg

-   AS: positive culture, symptom score = 0, =\< 2 episodes RVVC per year, now known as CTRLcul.pos

-   Control: negative culture, =\< 2 episodes RVVC per year, now known as CTRLcul.neg

In addition, the clinical score was used as a factor from score 0 to 5, to compare microbiome composition across an increasing score of inflammation. This score was determined by a experienced gynecologist and consisted of five categories marked present (1) or absent (0).

-   Fissures

-   Hyphae

-   Dryness

-   Discharge

-   Redness

Besides this, bulk transcriptomic data on the same vaginal swabs was used as inspiration for grouping of RVVCpos samples. In this previously published data (<https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/aji.70040>) two distinct clusters of RVVCpos samples were observed in the UMAP, one seperate cluster with high overall clinical scores and one cluster that mixes in with all the other diverse cross sectional samples and generally had a lower clinical score. These two clusters were used to subdivide the RVVCpos group into RVVCpos_seperate and RVVCpos_diverse for additional microbiome analysis.

All used data/files and generated output can be found on the server under: \~/Groups/Kristina Broliden/HIV group/Margaux/R work metagenomics + imaging/Swabs_functional

Further information on HUMAnN3 can be found: <https://github.com/biobakery/biobakery/wiki/humann3/#demo_pathabundancetsv>

In addition to the MetaCyc level of functional annotation, identified pathways were matched to so called superclasses to reduce the complexity in data and find overall functional shifts and changes. File2meco was used for this, more information can be found at: <https://github.com/ChiLiubio/file2meco/blob/master/README.md>

## Normalize to relative abundance

The raw output data using the Humann3 pipeline is in RPK form, this is normalized according to gene length. Relative abundance can be calculated by seeing what percentage each pathway covers in the total detected pathway abundance per sample, thereby creating a percentage.

```{r}
#| label: relative-abundance
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#############################
# RPK TO RELATIVE ABUNDANCE #
#############################

#rename first column name 
raw_path <- raw_path %>%
  rename(Pathway = "# Pathway")


#select the data at community level
path_community <- raw_path %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Pathway, "\\|"))

#calculate the sum reads per column (sample)
path_community <- path_community %>%
   bind_rows(
    summarise(
      .,
      Pathway = "Total",                
      across(where(is.numeric), sum)    
    )
  )

#path abundance/total path abundance per sample creates the relative path abundance (in percentage)
relative_path <- path_community %>%
  filter(Pathway != "Total") %>%                    
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . / sum(.)*100))   

#check the relative abundance per patient sums to 100
relative_path <- relative_path %>%
   bind_rows(
    summarise(
      .,
      Pathway = "Total",                
      across(where(is.numeric), sum)    
    )
  )

#round the data to five decimals and check if it still sums to 100 per patient
relative_path <- relative_path %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 5)))

#save this in a new data file
write_csv(relative_path, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/Functional_annotation_all_vagswab_relative_abundance.csv")

```

When calculating the total sum in reads per patient, it is approximately 1 million reads. This is what is expected. After selecting only the pathways at community level, 525 pathways are found, including the unmapped and unidentified.

## Quality control (negative and positive controls)

Negative (DNA/RNA shield) and positive (zymomock) control samples were included in the shotgun sequencing.

```{r}
#| label: quality-control
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

################################################
# QUALITY CONTROL NEGATIVE + POSITIVE CONTROLS #
################################################

#make the pathways the rownames 
relative_path <- relative_path %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Pathway")

#select negative controls 
neg_controls <- relative_path %>%
  dplyr::select(contains("neg"))

#inspect pathways represented in negative controls
neg_controls <- neg_controls %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Pathway")

neg_controls_detected <- neg_controls %>%
  filter(if_any(-Pathway, ~ . > 0)) %>%
  filter(Pathway != "Total")

neg_controls_long <- neg_controls_detected %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Pathway,          
    names_to = "Sample",       
    values_to = "Abundance"   
  )

neg_controls_plot <- ggplot(neg_controls_long, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Pathway)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Pathways Detected in Negative Control Samples", y = "Relative Abundance") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plot(neg_controls_plot)

ggsave(plot = neg_controls_plot, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/control/Functional_annotation_neg_controls_plot.png")

#select positive controls 
pos_controls <- relative_path %>%
  dplyr::select(contains("zymo"))

#inspect pathways represented in positive controls
pos_controls <- pos_controls %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Pathway")

pos_controls_detected <- pos_controls %>%
  filter(if_any(-Pathway, ~ . > 0)) %>%
  filter(Pathway != "Total")

pos_controls_detected <- pos_controls_detected %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Total_Pos_Abundance = sum(c_across(-Pathway))) %>%
  ungroup()

top10_pos_controls <- pos_controls_detected %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Pos_Abundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)


pos_controls_long <- top10_pos_controls %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total_Pos_Abundance) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Pathway,          
    names_to = "Sample",       
    values_to = "Abundance"   
  )

pos_controls_plot <- ggplot(pos_controls_long, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Pathway)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Pathways Detected in Positive Control Samples", y = "Relative Abundance") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plot(pos_controls_plot)

ggsave(plot = pos_controls_plot, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/control/Functional_annotation_pos_controls_plot.png")
```

Extraction and sequencing negative and positive controls identified, 10 in total. Both the negative and positive controls have practically 100% relative abundance associated with either unmapped or unintegrated pathways.

## Filtering

### Negative and positive controls removal

```{r}
#| label: filtering-controls
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###########################################
# FILTERING: NEGATIVE + POSITIVE CONTROL #
###########################################

#previously selected positive and negative controls, selection of column names
pos_controls <- pos_controls %>%
  dplyr::select(-Pathway)

neg_controls <- neg_controls %>%
  dplyr::select(-Pathway)

controls <- cbind(neg_controls, pos_controls)

write_csv(controls, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/control/Functional_annotation_controls.csv")

control_cols <- colnames(controls)
control_cols <- control_cols[control_cols != "Pathway"]

#remove these samples from the dataset 

relative_path <- relative_path %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(control_cols))
  
```

After removing the negative and positive control samples (10 in total), 159 samples are left in the data frame. The pathways have been moved to be the rownames.


### Pathways with very low relative abundance

To remove very low abundant taxa or functional pathways, pathways with less than 0.005% relative abundance in at least 10 samples are removed.

```{r}
#| label: filtering-low
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

############################
# FILTERING: LOW ABUNDANCE #
############################

#Pathways that have 0% relative abundance for all samples
null_pathways <- relative_path %>%
  filter(if_all(-Pathway, ~ . == 0))

relative_path <- relative_path %>%
  filter(if_any(-Pathway, ~ . != 0))

#pathways with <0.005% relative abundance in at least 10 samples
low_pathways <- relative_path %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(-Pathway, ~ . >= 0.005)) < 10)

write_csv(low_pathways, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/Functional_annotation_low_abundant_pathways.csv")

#remove low abundant pathways from data file
relative_path <- relative_path %>%
filter(rowSums(across(-Pathway, ~ . >= 0.005)) >= 10)

write_csv(relative_path, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/Functional_annotation_relative_abundance_filtered.csv")

```

91 identified pathways had no relative abundance across all samples and were removed. This means 429 pathways remain in the relative abundance data frame after their removal. Next, filtering based on the pathways relative abundance (more than 0.005% relative abundance in at least 10 samples) removed 314 low abundant pathways from the data frame, leaving 115 pathways of interest.

### Sample selection

Shotgun sequencing was performed in two runs since some samples were not included in the first run. To account for batch effects some samples were run in both runs. These are now present double in the relative abundance file and need to be removed once. The preferred samples to keep are the once run in the second run. Essentially, it doesn't matter which ones are removed since the taxonomic annotation indicated that both runs had the exact same species detected.

```{r}
#| label: sample-selection
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

####################
# SAMPLE SELECTION #
####################

#remove one version of the samples that were run twice (have _run2 in their name)
relative_path_norun2 <- relative_path %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains("run2"))

write_csv(relative_path_norun2, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/Functional_annotation_relative_abundance_filtered_norun2.csv")

#transpose data frame so samples are rows
relative_path_samplerows <- relative_path_norun2 %>%
  column_to_rownames("Pathway") %>%  
  t() %>%                            
  as.data.frame() %>%                
  rownames_to_column("svamp_ID") 

#select samples in cross sectional groups
sample_identification_cross <- sample_identification %>%
  filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"))

relative_path_cross <- relative_path_samplerows %>%
  filter(svamp_ID %in% sample_identification_cross$svamp_ID)

#add grouping column 
relative_path_cross <- relative_path_cross %>%
  left_join(sample_identification_cross %>% dplyr::select(group_cross, svamp_ID), by = "svamp_ID") 


#select samples in longitudinal groups
sample_identification_longi <- sample_identification %>%
  filter(group_longitudinal %in% c("FLZ_BL", "FLZ_1W", "FLZ_3M", "FLZ_6M"))

relative_path_longi <- relative_path_samplerows %>%
  filter(svamp_ID %in% sample_identification_longi$svamp_ID)

#add grouping column 
relative_path_longi <- relative_path_longi %>%
  left_join(sample_identification_longi %>% dplyr::select(group_longitudinal, svamp_ID), by = "svamp_ID") 


```

Removing the baseline samples that were run again in the second sequencing round for comparison, means that 5 less samples are included in the abundance data frame. Then samples of interest were selected for both the cross-sectional and longitudinal study set-ups. In the cross sectional data frame 80 samples are included, in the longitudinal 42 samples.

### Re-normalization

```{r}
#| label: re-normalization
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE

#| code-fold: true

###############

###############

#re-normalize the relative abundance data to 100% across each sample in cross sectional data

relative_path_cross_normalized <- relative_path_cross %>%
 rowwise() %>%

    where(is.numeric), 
    ~ .x / sum(c_across(where(is.numeric))) * 100
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

relative_path_cross_totals <- relative_path_cross_normalized %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_abundance = sum(c_across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%  
  ungroup()

#re-normalize the relative abundance data to 100% across each sample in longitudinal data 
relative_path_longi <- relative_path_longi %>%
  as.data.frame()

relative_path_longi <- relative_path_longi %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)

#relative_path_longi <- relative_path_longi %>%
  #select(-group_longitudinal.y)

#relative_path_longi <- relative_path_longi %>%
  #rename(group_longitudinal = group_longitudinal.x)

relative_path_longi <- relative_path_longi %>%
  mutate(across(-c(svamp_ID, group_longitudinal), ~ as.numeric(.)))

relative_path_longi_normalized <- relative_path_longi %>%
 rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric), 
    ~ .x / sum(c_across(where(is.numeric))) * 100
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

relative_path_longi_totals <- relative_path_longi_normalized %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_abundance = sum(c_across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%  
  ungroup()

```

## Differential abundance analysis

Differential abundance analysis is performed with Aldex2. This is a method designed to identify features that are differently abundant between experimental conditions while accounting for the compositional nature of the sequencing data. Compositional data means that our data is relative, not absolute. We know the proportion of reads per feature (relative abundance) which means that if one feature increases in number the other needs to appear to decrease even in absolute numvbers it doesn't (= compositional effect). Regular statistics can thus induce false positives or negatives since they assume absolute values. Aldex2 uses Dirichlet–Monte Carlo sampling and Centered Log-Ratio (CLR) transformation to model the nature of the data. Each sample’s counts (or relative abundances) are modeled as coming from a Dirichlet distribution, then Aldex2 simulates many (`mc.samples=128`) random realizations from that Dirichlet distribution.\
This generates a large number of possible relative abundance matrices, representing the uncertainty in the data. For each Monte Carlo instance, it computes the CLR value for each feature in each sample, this removes the compositional constraint and makes features comparable. Aldex2 requires a data frame with the samples as columns and the pathways as rows. The input data needs to be in the form of counts. Since we are working with relative abundance we can estimate the counts by multiplying the relative abundance per sample and pathway with the afterkraken2 read count (reads remaining after host removal). However, we need to use raw data and not previously normalized data since CLR normalization is done in the analysis itself. So first the raw read count pathway data needs to be transformed to relative abundance, then counts and then samples can be selected for analysis.

### Create estimated counts from relative abundance

```{r}
#| label: estimated-counts
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true
#| results: 'hide'

######################################################
# ESTIMATED COUNTS + DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE ANALYSIS #
######################################################

#install.packages("devtools")
#devtools::install_github("ggloor/ALDEx_bioc")

#if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    #install.packages("BiocManager")

#BiocManager::install("ALDEx2")

library(ALDEx2)

#use the afterkraken2 reads to estimate the counts from the relative abundance
kraken_counts <- read_csv("~/R_work/Clinical_trial_CHG_FLZ/250514_prepro_no_run_repeat.csv")

#get the barcode out of the sample_rowname and match to the sample_identifier svamp_ID
kraken_counts <- kraken_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample_rowname")

kraken_counts <- kraken_counts %>%
  mutate(barcode_shotgun_swab = str_extract(rownames(kraken_counts), "(?<=__)[A-Za-z0-9]+(?=__)"))

kraken_counts <- kraken_counts %>%
  left_join(sample_identification %>% dplyr::select(svamp_ID, barcode_shotgun_swab), by = "barcode_shotgun_swab")

#relative pathway abundance (but not further filtered and normalized)
aldex_relative_path <- read_csv("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/Functional_annotation_all_vagswab_relative_abundance.csv")

aldex_relative_path_samplerows <- aldex_relative_path %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Pathway") %>%  
  t() %>%                            
  as.data.frame() %>%                
  tibble::rownames_to_column("svamp_ID") 

aldex_relative_path_samplerows <- aldex_relative_path_samplerows %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(UNMAPPED, UNINTEGRATED))
  
#add the afterkraken column to the pathway abundance df (the sample_identification df doesn't have the controls and twice run samples so they are automatically not included in this df)
path_counts <- left_join(kraken_counts[, c("svamp_ID", "after_kraken2_host_removal")], aldex_relative_path_samplerows)

path_counts <- path_counts %>%
  dplyr::slice(-c(73,74))

path_counts <- path_counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)

#use the raw_path data to calculate the estimated counts for each sample (the relative abundace should not be in percentage so it gets divided by 100 and then multiplied by the kraken reads)
path_counts <- path_counts %>%
  mutate_at(vars(3:524), ~ after_kraken2_host_removal * 0.01 * .)
  
#counts as integers 
path_counts <- path_counts %>%
   mutate_at(c(3:524), as.integer)


#WITH FILTERED DATA
#relative pathway abudance filtered but not renormalized 
aldex_relative_path2 <- relative_path_norun2

aldex_relative_path_samplerows2 <- aldex_relative_path2 %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Pathway") %>%  
  t() %>%                            
  as.data.frame() %>%                
  tibble::rownames_to_column("svamp_ID") 

path_counts2 <- left_join(kraken_counts[, c("svamp_ID", "after_kraken2_host_removal")], aldex_relative_path_samplerows2)

path_counts2 <- path_counts2 %>%
  slice(-c(73,74))

path_counts2 <- path_counts2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)

path_counts2 <- path_counts2 %>%
  mutate_at(vars(3:116), ~ after_kraken2_host_removal * 0.01 * .)

path_counts2 <- path_counts2 %>%
   mutate_at(c(3:116), as.integer)

```

### Aldex2 differential abundance analysis - Control VS RVVCpos

```{r}
#| label: differential-abundance-control-RVVCpos
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true
#| results: 'hide'

#aldex metadata 
aldexmeta <- sample_identification %>%
  filter(group_cross %in% c("Control", "RVVCpos"))

#aldex data 
aldexdata <- path_counts

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  filter(svamp_ID %in% aldexmeta$svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(svamp_ID = factor(svamp_ID, levels = aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) %>%
  arrange(svamp_ID)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

aldexdata <- t(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- as.data.frame(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
  filter(!if_all(everything(), ~ . == 0))

aldexdata <- aldexdata[rownames(aldexdata) != "after_kraken2_host_removal", ]

#check if they match names
  setdiff(colnames(aldexdata), aldexmeta$svamp_ID) #no difference 

setdiff(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, colnames(aldexdata)) #S10 difference, in meta but not in counts (because is sample filtered out in taxonomic annotation due to low relative abundance)

aldexmeta <- aldexmeta %>%
  filter(svamp_ID != "S10")

all.equal(names(aldexdata),c(aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) #True


#Get the indices of the names in the same order
order_indices <- match(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, names(aldexdata))

#Reorder the columns to match the order 
aldexdata <- aldexdata[, order_indices]

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
mutate_at(c(1:61), as.integer)

#set the conditions to compare 
conds <-factor(aldexmeta$group_cross, levels=c("Control", "RVVCpos")) 

#vector needs to be character 
conds <- as.character(conds)

#aldex
x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross <- ALDEx2::aldex(aldexdata, conds, mc.samples=128, test="t", effect=TRUE,
     include.sample.summary=FALSE, denom="all", verbose=FALSE)

x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross <- x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Pathway")

write_csv(x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/dif abund/Functional_annotation_all_vagswab_differential_abundance_Control_RVVCpos.csv")


#USING FILTERED DATA 
#aldex metadata 
aldexmeta <- sample_identification %>%
  filter(group_cross %in% c("Control", "RVVCpos"))

#aldex data 
aldexdata <- path_counts2

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  filter(svamp_ID %in% aldexmeta$svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(svamp_ID = factor(svamp_ID, levels = aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) %>%
  arrange(svamp_ID)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

aldexdata <- t(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- as.data.frame(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
  filter(!if_all(everything(), ~ . == 0))

aldexdata <- aldexdata[rownames(aldexdata) != "after_kraken2_host_removal", ]

#check if they match names
  setdiff(colnames(aldexdata), aldexmeta$svamp_ID) #no difference 

setdiff(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, colnames(aldexdata)) #S10 difference, in meta but not in counts (because is sample filtered out in taxonomic annotation due to low relative abundance)

aldexmeta <- aldexmeta %>%
  filter(svamp_ID != "S10")

all.equal(names(aldexdata),c(aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) #True
```

### Most abundant pathways

explore the data by looking at the most abundant pathways

```{r}
#| label: most-abundant-pathways
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true
#| results: 'hide'

##########################
# MOST ABUNDANT PATHWAYS #
##########################

#Most abundant pathways in the cross sectional data 
relative_path_cross_top <- relative_path_cross_normalized %>%
  dplyr::select(-svamp_ID) %>%                             
  summarise(across(everything(), mean)) %>%         
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
               names_to = "Pathway", 
               values_to = "Mean_abundance") %>%    
  arrange(desc(Mean_abundance)) 

top30_cross <- head(relative_path_cross_top, 30)

top30_cross

#Barplot to visualize the most abundant pathways in the cross sectional data
plot_top30_cross <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  relative_path_cross_top %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(Mean_abundance, n = 30),
  ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(Pathway, Mean_abundance), y = Mean_abundance)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Pathway",
    y = "Mean Relative Abundance (%)",
    title = "Top 30 Most Abundant Pathways Across All Cross Sectional Samples"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()

plot_top30_cross

ggplot2::ggsave("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/top30/Functional_annotation_top30_pathways_cross_plot.png", plot = plot_top30_cross, bg = "white", width = 16, height = 12)

top30_longi
```

# Cross-sectional analysis

Pathway analysis performed on four cross-sectional groups based on fungal-growth and history of RVVC diagnosis.

```{r}
#| label: add-metadata
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

############
# METADATA #
############

#merge abundance data with clinical data (clinical score)
merged_relative_path_metadata_cross <- relative_path_cross_totals %>%
left_join(clinical_info %>% dplyr::select(svamp_ID, "Clinical score (0-5)"), by = "svamp_ID")

#sample identification
sample_identification <- read_xlsx("~/Desktop/svamp_ID_list.xlsx")

sample_identification_cross <- sample_identification %>%
    filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"))
```

## Alpha diversity

Alpha diversity including Shannon diversity, Inverse Simpson diversity and the pathway number are calculated for all samples. Comparisons are made between cross sectional groups, comparing the means. If there would be significant differences this would be highlighted in the figures by \*.

```{r}
#| label: alpha-diversity
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###################################
# ALPHA DIVERSITY CROSS-SECTIONAL #
###################################

mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized <- merged_relative_path_metadata_cross %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized <- as.data.frame(mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized)

mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized <- mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

shann_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized,index = c("shannon") )
simp_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized,index  = c("simpson") )
invsimp_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized,index  = c("invsimpson") )
spec_cross_df <-as.numeric(vegan::specnumber(mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized))
divers_cross <- as.matrix(rbind(shann_cross_df,simp_cross_df,invsimp_cross_df,spec_cross_df) )
divers_cross[is.infinite(divers_cross)] <- 0
rownames(divers_cross) <- c("Shannon","simpson","Inv Simpson","SpecNo")

divers_t_cross <-as.data.frame(t(divers_cross))%>%
  mutate(sample_ID=colnames(divers_cross))

divers_t_cross <- divers_t_cross %>%
  rownames_to_column("svamp_ID")

metadata_divers_cross <- sample_identification_cross %>%
  left_join(divers_t_cross, by = "svamp_ID")

metadata_divers_cross <- metadata_divers_cross %>%
  mutate(group_cross = factor(group_cross, 
                                  levels = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control")))


shann2_cross <- ggplot(metadata_divers_cross, aes (x=group_cross,y=Shannon,group=group_cross)) +
  geom_violin() +
  #geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(height = .2, width = .05)) +
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.2, size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.8,colour = "#B2007F", linewidth = 1.5)+theme_classic()+ggtitle("Shannon") +
  #stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",comparisons = list(c("RVVCpos","RVVCneg"),c("RVVCpos","AS"),c("RVVCpos","Control"),c("RVVCneg","AS"),c("RVVCneg","Control"),c("AS","Control")), hide.ns = FALSE, size = 10, bracket.size = 2 ) +
  labs(y = "Shannon", title = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(
  limits = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"),
  labels = c(
    expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
    expression(RVVC^"cul.neg"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.pos"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
  )
) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 20)), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20))

plot(shann2_cross)  

shann2_cross <- ggplot(metadata_divers_cross, aes (x=group_cross,y=Shannon,group=group_cross)) +
  geom_violin() +
  #geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(height = .2, width = .05)) +
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.2, size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.8,colour = "#B2007F", linewidth = 1.5)+theme_classic()+ggtitle("Shannon") +
   stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label.y = 4.5) +
  labs(y = "Shannon", title = NULL) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_x_discrete(
  limits = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"),
  labels = c(
    expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
    expression(RVVC^"cul.neg"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.pos"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
  )
) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 20)), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20))  




plot(shann2_cross)


simp2_cross <- ggplot(metadata_divers_cross, aes(x = group_cross, y = `Inv Simpson`, group = group_cross)) +
  geom_violin() +
  #geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(height = .2, width = .2)) +
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.2, size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.8, colour = "#B2007F", linewidth = 1.5) +
  ggtitle("Inverse Simpson") +
  #stat_compare_means(
    #label = "p.signif", 
    #comparisons = list(c("RVVCpos","RVVCneg"),c("RVVCpos","AS"),c("RVVCpos","Control"),c("RVVCneg","AS"),c("RVVCneg","Control"),c("AS","Control")), size = 10, bracket.size = 2 
  #) +
  labs(y = "Inverse Simpson", title = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(
  limits = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"),
  labels = c(
    expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
    expression(RVVC^"cul.neg"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.pos"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
  )
) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 20)), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20)
  )
  
plot(simp2_cross)


spec2_cross <- ggplot(metadata_divers_cross, aes (x=group_cross,y=SpecNo,group=group_cross)) +
  geom_violin() +
  #geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(height = .2, width = .2)) +
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.2, size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.8,colour = "#B2007F", linewidth = 1.5)+theme_classic()+ggtitle("Species Number") +
  #stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",comparisons = list(c("RVVCpos","RVVCneg"),c("RVVCpos","AS"),c("RVVCpos","Control"),c("RVVCneg","AS"),c("RVVCneg","Control"),c("AS","Control")), size = 10, bracket.size = 2 ) +
  labs(y = "Pathways number", title = NULL) +
 scale_x_discrete(
  limits = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"),
  labels = c(
    expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
    expression(RVVC^"cul.neg"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.pos"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
  )
) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 20)), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20))

plot(spec2_cross)

ggsave("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/alpha/shann_diversity.png", plot = shann2_cross, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/alpha/simp_diversity.png", plot = simp2_cross, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/alpha/spec_number.png", plot = spec2_cross, width = 12, height = 10)
```

No differences in alpha diversity of pathways across cross sectional groups.

## Beta diversity

```{r}
#| label: beta-diversity
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

##################################
# BETA DIVERSITY CROSS-SECTIONAL #
##################################

ordination_dysp_cross <-vegan::metaMDS(as.data.frame(mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized[,1:114]), distance="bray", plot=FALSE,autotransform = FALSE)

points_dysp_cross <-data.frame(ordination_dysp_cross$points[,1:2])

points_dysp_cross <- points_dysp_cross %>% 
  mutate(svamp_ID = rownames(points_dysp_cross))

meta_dysp_cross <- left_join(points_dysp_cross, sample_identification_cross)

meta_dysp_cross$group_cross <- factor(meta_dysp_cross$group_cross, 
                                                        levels = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"))

my_colors <- c(
  "RVVCpos" = "#F06F6F",  
  "RVVCneg" = "#8BBF45",  
  "AS"      = "#4ABAC0",  
  "Control" = "#9B5DE5"   
)


pcoa_cross <-ggplot(data=meta_dysp_cross, aes(x=MDS1, y=MDS2,)) +
  xlim(-1, 1.2) +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  geom_point(size=8, aes(color=group_cross), alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = group_cross, color = group_cross), 
               type = "t",        # statistical ellipse based on multivariate t-distribution
               level = 0.95,      # 95% confidence interval
               linetype = 1,      # dashed line
               linewidth = 1) +
  #geom_jitter(aes(color = group_assigned), size = 8, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.05, height = 0.05) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("MDS Bray") +
  scale_colour_manual(
  values = my_colors,
  breaks = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"),
  labels = c(
    expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
    expression(RVVC^"cul.neg"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.pos"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
  )
) +
  #scale_x_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
    legend.position = "right"
  )

plot(pcoa_cross)

ggsave(plot = pcoa_cross, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/beta/beta_diversity_cross.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

Based on bray-curtis distances visualized in a PCoA, no seperation in data based on cross-sectional grouping. RVVCcul.neg and CTRLcul.pos have smaller elipses but this is most likely due to their smaller sample size.

## Anosim

```{r}
#| label: anosim

##########################
# ANOSIM CROSS-SECTIONAL #
##########################

#remove SUM column

  #dplyr::filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S10", "S15"))

dist_matrix_cross <- vegdist(merged_relative_path_metadata_cross[, 2:115], method = "bray", na.rm = TRUE)

# Run anosim on the distance matrix
anosim(dist_matrix_cross, group = merged_relative_path_metadata_cross$group_cross, permutations = 999)

#0.959 not significant so the permutation ANOVA can be run
```

```{r}
#| label: clinical-permanova

#################################

#ordination points
ordination_dysp_cross_cs <-vegan::metaMDS(as.data.frame(mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized[,1:114]), distance="bray", plot=FALSE,autotransform = FALSE)

points_dysp_cross_cs <-data.frame(ordination_dysp_cross_cs$points[,1:2])

points_dysp_cross_cs <- points_dysp_cross_cs %>% 
  mutate(svamp_ID = rownames(points_dysp_cross))

    filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"))

    #left_join(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional %>% dplyr::select("sample_rowname", "svamp_ID"), by = "svamp_ID")

#turn the clinical score into a factor with levels (still named the grouping factor group_cross)
meta_dysp_cross_cs$group_cross <- factor(meta_dysp_cross_cs$`Clinical score (0-5)`, 
                                                        levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5"))

brighter_pastels <- c(
  "#FF69B4",  # hot pink

  "#BA55D3",  # orchid
  "#87CEFA",  # light blue
  "#98FB98",  # mint green
  "#EE82EE"   # violet
)

#PCoA plot (a form of overlaying the PCoA made before with the clinical score)
pcoa_cross_cs <- meta_dysp_cross_cs %>%
  filter(!is.na(group_cross)) %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = group_cross)) +
  xlim(-1.5, 1.5) +
  ylim(-1.5, 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 6, alpha = 0.8) +

  stat_ellipse(aes(group = group_cross), 
               type = "t",        
               level = 0.95,      
               linetype = 1,      
               linewidth = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("MDS Bray") +
  #scale_x_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(color = "Clinical score") +  
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),

    legend.text = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"),
```

## Overlay PCoA with main superclass2 pathways

PCoA of all participants colored by clinical score group and overlayed with superclass pathway vectors that explain the spread of variance along the PCoA axes

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-overlay
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

########################################
# PCOA CLINCAL SCORE + PATHWAY VECTORS #
########################################

meta_dysp2_cross <- left_join(points_dysp_cross, merged_relative_path_metadata_cross, by = c("svamp_ID"))

meta_dysp2_cross$group_cross <- factor(meta_dysp2_cross$group_cross, 
                                                        levels = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"))


#PCoA + envfit 
pathway_cols <- meta_dysp2_cross %>%
  dplyr::select(-svamp_ID, -group_cross, -MDS1, -MDS2) %>%
  colnames()

fit_all <- vegan::envfit(
  points_dysp_cross_cs[, c("MDS1", "MDS2")],
  meta_dysp2_cross[, pathway_cols],
  permutations = 999
)

vectors <- as.data.frame(fit_all$vectors$arrows * sqrt(fit_all$vectors$r))
vectors$pathway <- rownames(vectors)
vectors$pval <- fit_all$vectors$pvals
vectors$r2 <- fit_all$vectors$r


vectors_top <- vectors %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(r2)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:10)


label_map <- c(
  "PWY-6123: inosine-5'-phosphate biosynthesis I" =
    "IMP biosynthesis I",

  "PWY-6124: inosine-5'-phosphate biosynthesis II" =
    "IMP biosynthesis II",

  "PEPTIDOGLYCANSYN-PWY: peptidoglycan biosynthesis I (meso-diaminopimelate containing)" =
    "Peptidoglycan biosynthesis",

  "UDPNAGSYN-PWY: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine biosynthesis I" =
    "UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis",

  "PWY-6387: UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-pentapeptide biosynthesis I (meso-diaminopimelate containing)" =
    "Peptidoglycan precursor I",

  "PWY-6386: UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-pentapeptide biosynthesis II (lysine-containing)" =
    "Peptidoglycan precursor II",

  "PWY-7790: UMP biosynthesis II" =
    "UMP biosynthesis II",

  "PWY-7791: UMP biosynthesis III" =
    "UMP biosynthesis III",

  "P41-PWY: pyruvate fermentation to acetate and (S)-lactate I" =
    "Pyruvate fermentation I",

  "PWY-5100: pyruvate fermentation to acetate and lactate II" =
    "Pyruvate fermentation II", 

    "PWY-724: superpathway of L-lysine, L-threonine and L-methionine biosynthesis II" = "Amino acid biosynthesis"
)

vectors_top$label <- label_map[vectors_top$pathway]
vectors_top$label[is.na(vectors_top$label)] <- vectors_top$pathway

vectors_top$class <- dplyr::case_when(
  
  grepl("IMP|UMP", vectors_top$pathway) ~ "Nucleotide metabolism",
  
  grepl("PEPTIDOGLYCAN|UDPNAGSYN|MURAMOY", vectors_top$pathway) ~ "Cell wall biosynthesis",
  
  grepl("P41-PWY|PWY-5100|pyruvate", vectors_top$pathway, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Fermentation / energy metabolism",
  
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

class_colors <- c(
  "Nucleotide metabolism" = "#2C7BB6",
  "Cell wall biosynthesis" = "#D7191C",
  "Fermentation / energy metabolism" = "#1A9641",
  "Other" = "grey70"
)





p <- ggplot(points_dysp_cross_cs, aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2)) +
  
  #samples
  geom_point(
    color = "grey60",
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  
  #arrows colored by class
  geom_segment(
    data = vectors_top,
    aes(
      x = 0, y = 0,
      xend = MDS1,
      yend = MDS2,
      color = class
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors) +
  
  #labels
  geom_text_repel(
    data = vectors_top,
    aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, label = label),
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.8,
  point.padding = 0.6,
  force = 8,
  max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.2, 1.2), ylim = c(-1.2, 1.1)) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "PCoA with Functional Pathway Drivers",
    color = "Pathway class",
    x = "PCoA1",
    y = "PCoA2"
  )





#module PCoA
module_map <- list(

  "Nucleotide metabolism" = c(
    "PWY-6123: inosine-5'-phosphate biosynthesis I",
    "PWY-6124: inosine-5'-phosphate biosynthesis II",
    "PWY-7790: UMP biosynthesis II",
    "PWY-7791: UMP biosynthesis III"
  ),

  "Cell wall biosynthesis" = c(
    "PEPTIDOGLYCANSYN-PWY: peptidoglycan biosynthesis I (meso-diaminopimelate containing)",
    "UDPNAGSYN-PWY: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine biosynthesis I",
    "PWY-6387: UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-pentapeptide biosynthesis I (meso-diaminopimelate containing)",
    "PWY-6386: UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-pentapeptide biosynthesis II (lysine-containing)"
  ),

  "Fermentation / energy metabolism" = c(
    "P41-PWY: pyruvate fermentation to acetate and (S)-lactate I",
    "PWY-5100: pyruvate fermentation to acetate and lactate II"
  ),

  "Amino acid biosynthesis" = c(
    "PWY-724: superpathway of L-lysine, L-threonine and L-methionine biosynthesis II"
  )
)

for (m in names(module_map)) {

  cols <- module_map[[m]]

  meta_dysp2_cross[[m]] <- rowMeans(
    meta_dysp2_cross[, cols, drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}


module_matrix <- meta_dysp2_cross %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "Nucleotide metabolism",
    "Cell wall biosynthesis",
    "Fermentation / energy metabolism",
    "Amino acid biosynthesis"
  )

fit_mod <- envfit(
  meta_dysp2_cross[, c("MDS1", "MDS2")],
  module_matrix,
  permutations = 999
)

vectors_mod <- as.data.frame(fit_mod$vectors$arrows * sqrt(fit_mod$vectors$r))
vectors_mod$module <- rownames(vectors_mod)

module_colors <- c(
  "Nucleotide metabolism" = "#2C7BB6",
  "Cell wall biosynthesis" = "#D7191C",
  "Fermentation / energy metabolism" = "#1A9641",
  "Amino acid biosynthesis" = "#FDAE61"
)



p <- ggplot(meta_dysp2_cross, aes(MDS1, MDS2)) +

  geom_point(color = "grey70", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +

  geom_segment(
    data = vectors_mod,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = MDS1, yend = MDS2, color = module),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = vectors_mod,
    aes(MDS1, MDS2, label = module),
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.7,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = module_colors) +

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.2, 1.2), ylim = c(-1.1, 1.1)) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +

  labs(
    title = "PCoA of Functional Modules (envfit)",
    color = "Functional module"
  )

p

  
ggsave(plot = p, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/clinical score/pcoa_clinical_score_with_vectors.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)       
```

Shift away from amino acid biosynthesis and towards nucleotide and nucleoside biosynthesis with increasing clinical score.

```{r}
  dplyr::select(Pathway, spearman.ep) %>%
  mutate(sig = spearman.ep < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(sig, Pathway) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Pathway") %>%
  as.matrix()

  heatmap_mat,
  name = "Spearman r (significance before FDR)",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Spearman r\n(pre-FDR)",
    title_position = "topcenter",
    legend_width = unit(4, "cm")
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height,
                gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1, fill = NA))
    }
  }
)

pdf("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/clinical score/heatmap.pdf", width = 8, height = 20)

draw(heatmap_cs_pathways)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
divers_rvvc[is.infinite(divers_rvvc)] <- 0

  #stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",comparisons = list(c("RVVCpos_seperate","RVVCpos_diverse")), hide.ns = FALSE, size = 10, bracket.size = 2 ) +
  labs(y = "Shannon", title = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
```

## Permanova

```{r}
#| label: permanova-RVVCpos
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

######################
# PERMANOVA CLUSTERS #
######################

vegan::adonis2(samplerows_clustering[,2:115]~Cluster, data = samplerows_clustering, na.action = na.omit, permutations = 999,method="bray") #0.013


#heterogeneity 
bray_cluster <- vegan::vegdist(
  samplerows_clustering[, 2:115],
  method = "bray"
)

bd_cluster <- vegan::betadisper(
  bray_cluster,
  group = factor(samplerows_clustering$Cluster)
)

anova(bd_cluster)

```

Cluster explains about 8.3% of the variation in community composition, but not significant.

## Heterogeneity

```{r}
#| label: cluster-heterogeneity
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

##########################
# HETEROGENEITY CLUSTERS #
##########################

meta_cols <- c(
  "svamp_ID",
  "group_cross",
  "total_abundance",
  "Clinical score (0-5)",
  "Cluster"
)

#everything else = pathway data
pathway_cols <- setdiff(
  colnames(samplerows_clustering),
  meta_cols
)

pathway_data <- samplerows_clustering %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(pathway_cols))

#add pseudocount for zeros
pathway_pc <- pathway_data + 1e-6

#CLR transformation
pathway_clr <- as.data.frame(
  clr(pathway_pc)
)

pathway_dist <- dist(
  pathway_clr,
  method = "euclidean"
)


clusters <- factor(
  samplerows_clustering$Cluster
)

table(clusters)


pathway_dispersion <- betadisper(
  pathway_dist,
  group = clusters
)


set.seed(123)

pathway_dispersion_test <- permutest(
  pathway_dispersion,
  permutations = 9999
)

pathway_dispersion_test
#p = 0.7147


aggregate(
  pathway_dispersion$distances,
  by = list(Cluster = clusters),
  FUN = mean
)


aggregate(
  pathway_dispersion$distances,
  by = list(Cluster = clusters),
  FUN = median
)
#Diverse 44.36 - Seperate 40.87


pathway_dispersion_df <- data.frame(
  Cluster = clusters,
  Distance_to_centroid = pathway_dispersion$distances
)

cluster_labels <- c(
  "RVVCpos_diverse" = "Diverse",
  "RVVCpos_seperate" = "Separate"
)

pathway_heterogeneity_plot <- ggplot(
  pathway_dispersion_df,
  aes(
    x = Cluster,
    y = Distance_to_centroid
  )
) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.4,
    color = "#B2007F",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = cluster_labels
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 14
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Distance to cluster centroid"
  )

plot(pathway_heterogeneity_plot)


```

## Differential abundance analysis

```{r}
#| label: aldex2-RVVCpos
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true
#| results: 'hide'

###################################
# DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE CLUSTERS #
###################################

#aldex metadata 
aldexmeta <- clustering_groups %>%
  filter(`Cluster` %in% c("RVVCpos_seperate", "RVVCpos_diverse"))

#aldex data 
aldexdata <- path_counts2

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  filter(svamp_ID %in% aldexmeta$svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(svamp_ID = factor(svamp_ID, levels = aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) %>%
  arrange(svamp_ID)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

#aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
    #dplyr::select(-c("barcode_shotgun_swab", "after_kraken2_host_removal"))

aldexdata <- t(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- as.data.frame(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
  filter(!if_all(everything(), ~ . == 0))

#check if they match names
setdiff(colnames(aldexdata), aldexmeta$svamp_ID) #no differences

setdiff(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, colnames(aldexdata)) #S15

aldexmeta <- aldexmeta %>%
  filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S15"))

all.equal(names(aldexdata),c(aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) #TRUE


#Get the indices of the names in the same order
order_indices <- match(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, names(aldexdata))

#Reorder the columns to match the order 
aldexdata <- aldexdata[, order_indices]

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
mutate_at(c(1:18), as.integer)

#set the conditions to compare 
conds <-factor(aldexmeta$`Cluster`, levels=c("RVVCpos_seperate", "RVVCpos_diverse")) 

#vector needs to be character 
conds <- as.character(conds)

#aldex
x_all_RVVCpos_cluster <- ALDEx2::aldex(aldexdata, conds, mc.samples=128, test="t", effect=TRUE,
     include.sample.summary=FALSE, denom="all", verbose=FALSE)

x_all_RVVCpos_cluster <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "species")


write_csv(x_all_RVVCpos_cluster, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/RVVCpos clusters/dif_abundance_rvvc_clusters.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: aldex2-RVVCpos2
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE

#| code-fold: true


reactable(
  x_all_RVVCpos_cluster,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,  
  pagination = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10
)
```

PWY-724: superpathway of L-lysine, L-threonine and L-methionine biosynthesis II comes close to significance after FDR.

## Heatmaps

```{r}
#| label: heatmaps-functional
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

############
# HEATMAPS #
############

##################
# CLINICAL SCORE #
##################

#CLR normalization 
clr_data <- merged_relative_path_metadata_cross

clr_data[, 2:115] <- clr(clr_data[, 2:115] + 1e-6)

#only abundance data 
heat_dataclr <- as.matrix(clr_data[, 2:115])

#get rownames from svamp_ID
rownames(heat_dataclr) <- clr_data[[1]]

heat_dataclr_t <- t(heat_dataclr)

#hierarchical clustering
row_hclustclr <- hclust(dist(heat_dataclr_t), method = "ward.D2")   #pathways
col_hclustclr <- hclust(dist(t(heat_dataclr_t)), method = "ward.D2") #samples

#hclust objects to dendrograms
row_dendclr <- as.dendrogram(row_hclustclr)
col_dendclr <- as.dendrogram(col_hclustclr)

#clusters (adjust for how many color groups)
k_row <- 4
k_col <- 3

#colors for each cluster
row_colors <- brewer.pal(k_row, "Pastel1")
col_colors <- brewer.pal(k_col, "Pastel2")

#colors for dendrites
row_dend_colored <- color_branches(row_dendclr, k = k_row, col = row_colors)
col_dend_colored <- color_branches(col_dendclr, k = k_col, col = col_colors)

#extract group column 
sample_groups <- clr_data$group_cross
names(sample_groups) <- colnames(heat_dataclr_t)

#color for each group
group_levels <- unique(sample_groups)
group_colors <- my_colors
names(group_colors) <- group_levels

#bar above heatmap - clinical score
clr_data_cs <- clr_data

clinical_score_fac <- clr_data_cs %>%
  dplyr::select(svamp_ID, `Clinical score (0-5)`) %>%
  filter(svamp_ID %in% colnames(heat_dataclr_t)) %>%
  arrange(match(svamp_ID, colnames(heat_dataclr_t))) %>%
  pull(`Clinical score (0-5)`) %>%
  factor(levels = 0:5, ordered = TRUE)

score_colors <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(6, "YlOrRd"),
  levels(clinical_score_fac)
)

#bar above heatmap
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = sample_groups,
  ClinicalScore = clinical_score_fac,
  col = list(
    Group = group_colors,
    ClinicalScore = score_colors
  ),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(title = "Sample Group"),
    ClinicalScore = list(title = "Clinical score (0–5)")
  )
)

heatmap_clr <- Heatmap(
  heat_dataclr_t,
  name = "clr(Pathways abundance)",
  col = colorRamp2(
    c(min(heat_dataclr_t), 0, max(heat_dataclr_t)),
    c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42") 
  ),
  cluster_rows = row_dend_colored,    
  cluster_columns = col_dend_colored,  
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")),
  show_heatmap_legend = TRUE, 
  top_annotation = col_ha
)

heatmap_clr

#ordered by clinical score

heat_dataclr_t_ordered <- heat_dataclr_t[, col_order]

# Reorder annotation accordingly

clinical_score_fac_ordered <- clinical_score_fac[col_order]

heat_dataclr <- as.matrix(clr_data[, 2:115])
rownames(heat_dataclr) <- clr_data[[1]]
heat_dataclr_t <- t(heat_dataclr)

#taxa clustering only
row_hclustclr <- hclust(dist(heat_dataclr_t), method = "ward.D2")
row_dendclr <- as.dendrogram(row_hclustclr)



#extract group column 
sample_groups <- clr_data$Cluster
names(sample_groups) <- colnames(heat_dataclr_t)

group_levels <- unique(sample_groups)
group_colors <- c("#80B1D3", "#A8D5BA")
names(group_colors) <- group_levels

#join clinical scores
clr_data_cs <- clr_data 

clinical_score_fac <- clr_data_cs %>%
  filter(svamp_ID %in% colnames(heat_dataclr_t)) %>%
  arrange(match(svamp_ID, colnames(heat_dataclr_t))) %>%
  pull(`Clinical score (0-5)`) %>%
  factor(levels = 0:5, ordered = TRUE)

score_colors <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(6, "YlOrRd"),
  levels(clinical_score_fac)
)

#ORDER SAMPLES BY CLINICAL SCORE (0-5)
col_order <- order(as.numeric(as.character(clinical_score_fac)))

heat_dataclr_t_ordered <- heat_dataclr_t[, col_order]
sample_groups_ordered <- sample_groups[col_order]
clinical_score_fac_ordered <- clinical_score_fac[col_order]

#top annotation
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = sample_groups_ordered,
  ClinicalScore = clinical_score_fac_ordered,
  col = list(
    Group = group_colors,
    ClinicalScore = score_colors
  ),
  show_legend = FALSE
)

png("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/heatmaps/Heatmap_RVVCclusters_by_clinical_score.png", width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)

heatmap_clr_plot <- Heatmap(
  heat_dataclr_t_ordered,
  name = "clr(Abundance)",
  col = colorRamp2(
    c(min(heat_dataclr_t_ordered), 0, max(heat_dataclr_t_ordered)),
    c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42") 
  ),
  cluster_rows = row_dendclr,   
  cluster_columns = FALSE,      
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 1),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")),
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE, 
  top_annotation = col_ha, 
    row_names_max_width = unit(16, "cm")
)

  
png("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/heatmaps/Heatmap_RVVCclusters_by_clinical_score.png", width = 5000, height = 8000, res = 300)

  
plot(heatmap_clr_plot)

  dev.off()

```

## Species contribution to pathways abundance

To what percentage do different species contribute to the abundance of individual pathways

```{r}
#| label: species-contribution
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

################################
# SPECIES PATHWAY CONTRIBUTION #
################################

#ra_samplerows_cross_cs has the pathways that were left after filtering 
keep_pathways <- colnames(ra_samplerows_cross_cs)[2:115]

pattern <- str_c(str_escape(keep_pathways), collapse = "|")

#raw file with contribution per pathway -> raw_path
raw_path_filtered <- raw_path %>%
  filter(str_detect(Pathway, pattern))

#sample_identification for groups 
meta_cross <- sample_identification %>%
  filter(group_cross %in% c("AS", "Control", "RVVCneg", "RVVCpos")) %>%
  dplyr::select(svamp_ID, group_cross)

#renormalize and into long format 

stratified <- raw_path_filtered %>%
  filter(str_detect(Pathway, "\\|")) %>%
  separate(Pathway, into = c("Pathway", "Taxa"), sep = "\\|")


strat_long <- stratified %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Pathway, Taxa),
    names_to = "svamp_ID",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

strat_long <- strat_long %>%
  filter(svamp_ID %in% meta_cross$svamp_ID) %>%
  left_join(meta_cross, by = "svamp_ID") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(svamp_ID, "neg|zymo|run2"))

strat_long <- strat_long %>%
  group_by(svamp_ID, Pathway) %>%
  mutate(percentage_contribution = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

#aggregation based on group-weighted mean 
#contribution_group <- strat_long %>%
  #group_by(group_cross, Pathway, Taxa) %>%
 # summarise(
    #percentage_contribution = sum(Abundance) / sum(sum(Abundance)) * 100,
   # .groups = "drop"
 # )

contribution_group <- strat_long %>%
  group_by(group_cross, Pathway, Taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    percentage_contribution = mean(percentage_contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#top most abundant pathways selection
TOP_PATHWAYS <- 20
TOP_TAXA <- 20


make_group_plot <- function(df_group, group_name) {
  
  #top pathways
  top_pathways <- df_group %>%
    group_by(Pathway) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(percentage_contribution), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    slice_head(n = TOP_PATHWAYS) %>%
    pull(Pathway)
  
  #top taxa
  top_taxa <- df_group %>%
    group_by(Taxa) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(percentage_contribution), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    slice_head(n = TOP_TAXA) %>%
    pull(Taxa)
  
  plot_df <- df_group %>%
    filter(Pathway %in% top_pathways,
           Taxa %in% top_taxa)
  
  #clean pathway names
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway_clean = Pathway %>%
        str_remove("^PWY-[0-9]+:\\s*") %>%
        str_replace_all(" \\(.*?\\)", "") %>%
        str_trim() %>%
        str_wrap(30)
    )
  
  #clean taxa names PROPERLY
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa_clean = Taxa %>%
      str_remove("^.*\\|") %>%          
      str_replace_all("\\.", " ") %>%   
      str_squish() %>%                  
      {
        parts <- str_split(., " ", simplify = TRUE)
        paste0(substr(parts[,1], 1, 1), ". ", parts[,2])
      }
  )
  
  #force consistent ordering
  plot_df$Pathway_clean <- factor(
    plot_df$Pathway_clean,
    levels = rev(unique(plot_df$Pathway_clean))
  )
  
  plot_df$Taxa_clean <- factor(
    plot_df$Taxa_clean,
    levels = unique(plot_df$Taxa_clean)
  )
  
  #plot
  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = Taxa_clean,
             y = Pathway_clean,
             fill = percentage_contribution)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#f2e5ff",
      high = "#4b00b5",
      name = "Contribution (%)"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(
      title = group_name,
      x = "Taxa",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                 hjust = 1,
                                 size = 5,
                                 face = "italic"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                size = 14,
                                hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10,10,10,10)
    )
}


p_AS      <- make_group_plot(contribution_group %>% filter(group_cross == "AS"), "AS")
p_Control <- make_group_plot(contribution_group %>% filter(group_cross == "Control"), "Control")
p_RVVCneg <- make_group_plot(contribution_group %>% filter(group_cross == "RVVCneg"), "RVVCneg")
p_RVVCpos <- make_group_plot(contribution_group %>% filter(group_cross == "RVVCpos"), "RVVCpos")

make_clinical_plot <- function(df_group, score_name) {
  
  #top pathways
  top_pathways <- df_group %>%

    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    slice_head(n = TOP_PATHWAYS) %>%

  #top taxa

    group_by(Taxa) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(percentage_contribution), .groups = "drop") %>%

    slice_head(n = TOP_TAXA) %>%
    pull(Taxa)
  
  plot_df <- df_group %>%
    filter(Pathway %in% top_pathways,
           Taxa %in% top_taxa)
  
  #clean pathway names
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway_clean = Pathway %>%
        str_remove("^PWY-[0-9]+:\\s*") %>%
        str_replace_all(" \\(.*?\\)", "") %>%
        str_trim() %>%
        str_wrap(30)
    )
  
  #clean taxa names
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa_clean = Taxa %>%
      str_remove("^.*\\|") %>%          
      str_replace_all("\\.", " ") %>%   
      str_squish() %>%                 
      {
        parts <- str_split(., " ", simplify = TRUE)
        paste0(substr(parts[,1], 1, 1), ". ", parts[,2])
      }
  )
  
  #factor ordering
  plot_df$Pathway_clean <- factor(
    plot_df$Pathway_clean,
    levels = rev(unique(plot_df$Pathway_clean))
  )
  
  plot_df$Taxa_clean <- factor(
    plot_df$Taxa_clean,
    levels = unique(plot_df$Taxa_clean)
  )
  
  #tile plot
  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = Taxa_clean,

    scale_fill_gradient(

                                size = 14,
                                hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10,10,10,10)
    )
}

      Pathway_clean = Pathway %>%
        str_replace_all(" \\(.*?\\)", "") %>%
        str_trim() %>%
        str_wrap(30)
    )
  
  #clean taxa names
     plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa_clean = Taxa %>%
      str_remove("^.*\\|") %>%          
      str_replace_all("\\.", " ") %>%   
      str_squish() %>%                  
      {
        parts <- str_split(., " ", simplify = TRUE)
        paste0(substr(parts[,1], 1, 1), ". ", parts[,2])
      }
  )
  
  #ordering
  plot_df$Pathway_clean <- factor(
    plot_df$Pathway_clean,
    levels = rev(unique(plot_df$Pathway_clean))
  )
  
  plot_df$Taxa_clean <- factor(
    plot_df$Taxa_clean,
    levels = unique(plot_df$Taxa_clean)
  )
  
  #plot (IDENTICAL STYLE)
  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = Taxa_clean,
             y = Pathway_clean,
             fill = percentage_contribution)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#f2e5ff",
      high = "#4b00b5",
      name = "Contribution (%)"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(
      title = group_name,
      x = "Taxa",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                 hjust = 1,
                                 size = 5,
                                 face = "italic"),
       axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                size = 14,
                                hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10,10,10,10)
    )
}
```

# Analysis at Superclass level

A MetaCyc pathway hierarchy map is used to create a superclass level of pathways to increase the interpretability of data. All Human3 output pathways are matched to these superclasses. More information can be found on: <https://github.com/ChiLiubio/file2meco/blob/master/README.md>

## Match to biological pathway groups (superclasses)

```{r}
#| label: superclass-level
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

##################
# MATCH PATHWAYS #
##################

#this file was downloaded from:
#https://github.com/ChiLiubio/file2meco/blob/master/data/MetaCyc_pathway_map.RData

#load MetaCyc pathway hierarchy map
mc_env <- new.env()
load("/Users/marbal/Downloads/MetaCyc_pathway_map.RData", envir = mc_env)

#inspect contents
ls(mc_env)

#pull the object (assuming one main object in file)
pathway_map <- mc_env[[ls(mc_env)]] %>% as_tibble(rownames = "pathway_id")
head(pathway_map)

#check structure
str(pathway_map)

#add superclass level columns to data (need pathways to be rows)
#relative_path_cross_totals_t <- relative_path_cross_totals %>%
  #column_to_rownames("svamp_ID") %>%   
  #t() %>%                              
  #as.data.frame() %>%
  #rownames_to_column("Pathway")

relative_path_cross_totals_t <- relative_path_cross_totals %>%
  column_to_rownames("svamp_ID") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ readr::parse_number(as.character(.)))) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Pathway")

FM_data <- relative_path_cross_totals_t

FM_data <- FM_data %>%
  separate("Pathway", into = c("pathway_id", "Pathway"), sep = ": ") %>%
  left_join(
    pathway_map,
    by = "pathway_id"
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    any_of(c("Superclass1", "Superclass2", "pathway")),
    .after = "pathway_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-pathway)

write_csv(FM_data, "~/R_work/Selection_raw_data/Functional_annotation_vagswabs_cross_cohort_match_superclasses.csv")

#number of pathways per superclass
superclass_counts <- c("Superclass1", "Superclass2") %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(
    .,
    ~ FM_data %>%
      #filter(!pathway_id %in% c("UNMAPPED", "UNINTEGRATED")) %>%
      summarise(
        n_pathways = n_distinct(pathway_id),
        total_abundance = sum(
          rowSums(pick(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE),
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .by = .x
      ) %>%
      mutate(perc_total = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance) * 100) %>%
      arrange(desc(perc_total))
  )
```

## Cross-sectional barplots

across four cross-sectional groups

```{r}
#| label: superclass-cross
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

##############################
# CROSS-SECTIONAL SUPERCLASS #
##############################

library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)

meta_group <- "Superclass2"
subgroup <- "Pathway"

#helper functions
get_order <- function(df, id, value) {
  id <- enquo(id)
  id_name <- as_label(id)
  value <- enquo(value)

  df %>%
    group_by(!!id) %>%
    add_tally(wt = !!value, sort = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(!!id_name := forcats::fct_reorder(!!id, n))
}

legend_height_cm <- function(leg) {
  convertHeight(sum(leg$heights), "cm", valueOnly = TRUE)
}

get_legend.fun <- function(df, title, id, colours, txt_size = 5) {

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(fill = annot, y = abundance, x = .data[[id]])) +
    geom_col() +

    scale_fill_manual(title, values = colours[unique(df$annot)]) +

    guides(fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 1,
      byrow = FALSE,
      override.aes = list(size = 0.3),
      keyheight = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      keywidth  = unit(0.18, "cm")
    )) +

    theme_void() +

    theme(
      text = element_text(size = txt_size),
      legend.title = element_text(
        size = 6,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(b = 1)
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.01, "cm"),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(0,0,0,0)
    )

  cowplot::get_legend(p)
}

#make column 5 to 84 numeric 
#FM_data <- FM_data %>%
 #mutate(across(5:84, as.numeric))

#remove unneeded rows from FM_data 
FM_data <- FM_data %>%
slice(-c(115, 116))

#long format and normalized 
df_long <- FM_data %>%
  filter(!pathway_id %in% c("UNMAPPED", "UNINTEGRATED")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 5:84,   
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(abundance = replace_na(abundance, 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    abundance = abundance / sum(abundance) * 100,
    .by = sample
  )

df_long %>%
  summarise(total = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .by = sample) %>%
  arrange(total)

#order Superclass2 by median abundance
ord <- df_long %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance), .by = c(sample, Superclass2)) %>%
  summarise(p_median = median(abundance), .by = Superclass2) %>%
  arrange(desc(p_median))

meta_group_lvl <- ord$Superclass2[1:12]

df <- df_long %>%
  mutate(
    Superclass2 = ifelse(Superclass2 %in% meta_group_lvl, Superclass2, "Other"),
    Pathway = ifelse(Superclass2 == "Other", "Other", Pathway)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pathway = ifelse(is.na(Pathway), paste0("NA_", cur_group_id()), Pathway),
    .by = Superclass2
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    meta_group = factor(Superclass2, levels = c(meta_group_lvl, "Other")),
    annot = Pathway
  ) %>%
  arrange(meta_group)

#order pathways by Superclass2
lvl <- df %>%
  distinct(meta_group, Pathway) %>%
  pull(Pathway) %>%
  unique()

df <- df %>%
  mutate(annot = factor(annot, levels = lvl))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    top_pthw = ifelse(
      Superclass2 == "Nucleoside and Nucleotide Biosynthesis",
      abundance,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  get_order(id = sample, top_pthw)

#colours
library(colorspace)

base_cols <- c(
  "Nucleoside and Nucleotide Biosynthesis" = "#8FA6D6",  # blue
  "Cofactor, Carrier, and Vitamin Biosynthesis" = "#FFD21F",  # yellow
  "Fermentation" = "#FFA07A",  # salmon
  "Cell Structure Biosynthesis" = "#E78AC3",  # pink
  "Fatty Acid and Lipid Biosynthesis" = "#66C2A5",  # teal green
  "Carbohydrate Biosynthesis" = "#C8E6A0",  # light green
  "Amino Acid Biosynthesis" = "#F26C6C",  # coral red
  "Aminoacyl-tRNA Charging" = "#4F81BD",  # blue
  "Carbohydrate Degradation" = "#9E6BB2",  # purple
  "Secondary Metabolite Biosynthesis" = "#4CAF50",  # green
  "Glycolysis" = "#E5C07B",  # beige/gold
  "Amide, Amidine, Amine, and Polyamine Degradation" = "#38BFD0",  # cyan
  "Other" = "#BDBDBD"
)

FM_colours <- df %>%
  distinct(meta_group, annot) %>%
  arrange(meta_group, annot) %>%
  group_by(meta_group) %>%
  mutate(
    n_pathways = n(),
    base_col = base_cols[as.character(meta_group)],
    pathway_col = ifelse(
      n_pathways == 1,
      base_col,
      colorspace::lighten(
        base_col,
        amount = seq(0, 0.65, length.out = n_pathways)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(annot, pathway_col) %>%
  deframe()

#grouped legends

    rel_height = height / sum(height)
  )
```

## Original PCoA overlay

The original PCoA created based on bray-curtis distances between the 114 pathways from the human3 output is overlayed by vectors that represent how superclass2 explains the variation in data points.

```{r}
#| label: superclass-pcoa
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#####################################
# PCOA OVERLAY - SUPERCLASS VECTORS #
#####################################

#use superclass2 to create envfit vectors 

#create Superclass2 matrix
superclass_matrix <- FM_data %>%
  
  dplyr::select(
    Pathway,
    Superclass2,
    where(is.numeric)
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),
    names_to = "svamp_ID",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  
  group_by(svamp_ID, Superclass2) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Superclass2,
    values_from = abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  )

meta_superclass <- points_dysp_cross_cs %>%
  left_join(superclass_matrix, by = "svamp_ID")

superclass_cols <- meta_superclass %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -svamp_ID,
    -MDS1,
    -MDS2
  ) %>%
  colnames()

fit_super <- vegan::envfit(
  meta_superclass[, c("MDS1", "MDS2")],
  meta_superclass[, superclass_cols],
  permutations = 999
)

vectors_super <- as.data.frame(
  fit_super$vectors$arrows * sqrt(fit_super$vectors$r)
)

vectors_super$Superclass2 <- rownames(vectors_super)
vectors_super$pval <- fit_super$vectors$pvals
vectors_super$r2 <- fit_super$vectors$r

superclass_colors <- c(
  "Nucleoside and Nucleotide Biosynthesis" = "#8FA6D6",
  "Cofactor, Carrier, and Vitamin Biosynthesis" = "#FFD21F",
  "Fermentation" = "#FFA07A",
  "Cell Structure Biosynthesis" = "#E78AC3",
  "Fatty Acid and Lipid Biosynthesis" = "#66C2A5",
  "Carbohydrate Biosynthesis" = "#C8E6A0",
  "Amino Acid Biosynthesis" = "#F26C6C",
  "Aminoacyl-tRNA Charging" = "#4F81BD",
  "Carbohydrate Degradation" = "#9E6BB2",
  "Secondary Metabolite Biosynthesis" = "#4CAF50",
  "Glycolysis" = "#E5C07B",
  "Amide, Amidine, Amine, and Polyamine Degradation" = "#38BFD0",
  "Other" = "#BDBDBD", 
  "Other Biosynthesis" = "#D4A5FF", 
  "Carbohydrate Degradation&&Polymeric Compound Degradation" = "#9E6BB2"
)

vectors_super <- vectors_super %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MDS1),
    !is.na(MDS2),
    is.finite(MDS1),
    is.finite(MDS2),
    MDS1 != 0 | MDS2 != 0
  )


vectors_super <- vectors_super %>%
  arrange(desc(r2)) %>%
  slice(1:10)

p <- ggplot(meta_superclass, aes(MDS1, MDS2)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey70", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +

  geom_segment(
    data = vectors_super,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = MDS1, yend = MDS2, color = Superclass2),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = superclass_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-1.2, 1.2),
    ylim = c(-1.2, 1.2),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

p


ggsave(
  "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/superclass/PCOA_superclass.png",
  p,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  bg = "white",
  dpi = 500
)
```

## Volcano plots aldex2 before FDR colored by superclass2 - RVVCpos clusters

Original volcano plot from differential abundance analysis between transcriptomic clusters (before FDR) colored by superclass matching

```{r}
#| label: superclass-volcano 
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

############################################
# VOLCANO PLOT SUPERCLASS COLOR BEFORE FDR #
############################################

species_levels <- unique(x_all_RVVCpos_cluster$species)
species_count <- length(species_levels)

color_palette_volcano <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(species_count), species_levels)

significant_species_difabu <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
  filter(abs(diff.btw) > 1 & wi.ep < 0.05)

significant_species <- significant_species_difabu$species 

#define cutoffs
fc_cutoff <- 1
p_cutoff <- 0.05

#is the species significant or not 
x_all_RVVCpos_cluster <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      diff.btw > fc_cutoff & wi.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Up",
      diff.btw < -fc_cutoff & wi.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "Non-significant")
  )

#colors
volcano_colors <- c(
  "Up" = "hotpink",          #pink
  "Down" = "#2166ac",        # blue
  "Non-significant" = "gray70"
)

#labels in figure 
sig_species <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
  filter(significance != "Non-significant") %>%
  mutate(
    pretty_label = paste0(
      "italic('",
      gsub("_", " ", sub("^s__", "", species)),
      "')"
    )
  )

#volcano plot with cutoffs (significance and fold change)
volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR <- ggplot(x_all_RVVCpos_cluster,
                       aes(x = diff.btw, y = -log10(wi.ep), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = sig_species,
    aes(label = pretty_label),
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
    title = "Volcano Plot: RVVCpos_seperate vs RVVCpos_diverse"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

#plot(volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR)

ggsave(plot = volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/superclass/volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR.png", bg = "white")


#pathways colored by superclass2 
#map pathways to Superclass2
pathway_superclass_map <- FM_data %>%
  mutate(
    species = paste(pathway_id, Pathway, sep = ": ")
  ) %>%
  distinct(species, Superclass2)

x_all_RVVCpos_cluster <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("Superclass2", "volcano_group"))) %>%
  left_join(pathway_superclass_map, by = "species") %>%
  mutate(
    volcano_group = ifelse(
      significance == "Non-significant",
      "Non-significant",
      Superclass2
    )
  )


base_cols_extended <- c(
  "Nucleoside and Nucleotide Biosynthesis" = "#8FA6D6",  # blue

volcano_superclass_colors <- c(

sig_species <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
```

```{r}
#################################

  inner_join(clinical_meta, by = "svamp_ID")

  dplyr::select(
    -svamp_ID,
    -after_kraken2_host_removal,
    -clinical_score
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

  identical(
    colnames(pathway_counts),
    dat_aldex$svamp_ID
  )
)

  rowSums(pathway_counts) > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

set.seed(123)

aldex_clr <- aldex.clr(
  pathway_counts,
  conds = conds,
  mc.samples = 128,
  denom = "all",
  verbose = TRUE
)


kw <- aldex.kw(aldex_clr)


kw_results <- kw %>%
  rownames_to_column("Pathway") %>%
  arrange(kw.eBH)

write_csv(kw_results, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/dif abund/aldex_clinical_score_kw.csv")
```

## Relative abundance data frame of the superclass2 level

Created before in code but made sure that the abundance sums to 100% for each participant

```{r}
#| label: superclass-abundance  
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#################################
# SUPERCLASS RELATIVE ABUNDANCE #
#################################

superclass_matrix <- FM_data %>%

  dplyr::select(
    Pathway,
    Superclass2,
    where(is.numeric)
  ) %>%

  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),
    names_to = "svamp_ID",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%

  group_by(svamp_ID, Superclass2) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  #normalize each sample to 100%
  group_by(svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    abundance = abundance / sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Superclass2,
    values_from = abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  )


write_csv(superclass_matrix, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/superclass/Pathway_abudance_superclass_level.csv")
```

## Alpha diversity

```{r}
#| label: superclass-alpha

# ALPHA DIVERSITY SUPERCLASS #

#cross-sectional 
superclass_matrix_cross_alpha <- superclass_matrix_cross %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

superclass_matrix_cross_alpha <- as.data.frame(superclass_matrix_cross_alpha)

superclass_matrix_cross_alpha <- superclass_matrix_cross_alpha %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

shann_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(superclass_matrix_cross_alpha,index = c("shannon") )
simp_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(superclass_matrix_cross_alpha,index  = c("simpson") )
invsimp_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(superclass_matrix_cross_alpha,index  = c("invsimpson") )
spec_cross_df <-as.numeric(vegan::specnumber(superclass_matrix_cross_alpha))
divers_cross <- as.matrix(rbind(shann_cross_df,simp_cross_df,invsimp_cross_df,spec_cross_df) )
divers_cross[is.infinite(divers_cross)] <- 0
rownames(divers_cross) <- c("Shannon","simpson","Inv Simpson","SpecNo")

divers_t_cross <-as.data.frame(t(divers_cross))%>%
  mutate(sample_ID=colnames(divers_cross))

divers_t_cross <- divers_t_cross %>%
  rownames_to_column("svamp_ID")

  left_join(divers_t_cross, by = "svamp_ID")

  mutate(group_cross = factor(group_cross,
```
