```{r}
#cross-sectional 
superclass_matrix_cross_beta <- superclass_matrix_cross %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

ordination_dysp_cross <-vegan::metaMDS(as.data.frame(superclass_matrix_cross_beta[,1:21]), distance="bray", plot=FALSE,autotransform = FALSE)

points_dysp_cross <-data.frame(ordination_dysp_cross$points[,1:2])

points_dysp_cross <- points_dysp_cross %>% 
  mutate(svamp_ID = rownames(points_dysp_cross))

meta_dysp_cross <- left_join(points_dysp_cross, superclass_matrix_cross %>% 
      dplyr::select(svamp_ID, group_cross),
    by = "svamp_ID")

meta_dysp_cross$group_cross <- factor(meta_dysp_cross$group_cross, 
                                                        levels = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"))

my_colors <- c(
  "RVVCpos" = "#F06F6F",  
  "RVVCneg" = "#8BBF45",  
  "AS"      = "#4ABAC0",  
  "Control" = "#9B5DE5"   
)


pcoa_cross <-ggplot(data=meta_dysp_cross, aes(x=MDS1, y=MDS2,)) +
  xlim(-1, 1.2) +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  geom_point(size=8, aes(color=group_cross), alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = group_cross, color = group_cross), 
               type = "t",        # statistical ellipse based on multivariate t-distribution
               level = 0.95,      # 95% confidence interval
               linetype = 1,      # dashed line
               linewidth = 1) +
  #geom_jitter(aes(color = group_assigned), size = 8, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.05, height = 0.05) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("MDS Bray") +
  scale_colour_manual(
  values = my_colors,
  breaks = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"),
  labels = c(
    expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
    expression(RVVC^"cul.neg"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.pos"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
  )
) +
  #scale_x_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
    legend.position = "right"
  )

plot(pcoa_cross)

ggsave("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/superclass/pcoa_cross_superclass.png", plot = pcoa_cross, width = 8, height = 6)

  left_join(superclass_matrix, by = "svamp_ID")

    -svamp_ID,
    -MDS1,
    -MDS2
  ) %>%
  colnames()

  meta_superclass[, c("MDS1", "MDS2")],
  meta_superclass[, superclass_cols],
  permutations = 999
)

vectors_super <- as.data.frame(
  fit_super$vectors$arrows * sqrt(fit_super$vectors$r)
)

vectors_super$Superclass2 <- rownames(vectors_super)
vectors_super$pval <- fit_super$vectors$pvals
vectors_super$r2 <- fit_super$vectors$r

superclass_colors <- c(
  "Nucleoside and Nucleotide Biosynthesis" = "#8FA6D6",
  "Cofactor, Carrier, and Vitamin Biosynthesis" = "#FFD21F",
  "Fermentation" = "#FFA07A",
  "Cell Structure Biosynthesis" = "#E78AC3",
  "Fatty Acid and Lipid Biosynthesis" = "#66C2A5",
  "Carbohydrate Biosynthesis" = "#C8E6A0",
  "Amino Acid Biosynthesis" = "#F26C6C",
  "Aminoacyl-tRNA Charging" = "#4F81BD",
  "Carbohydrate Degradation" = "#9E6BB2",
  "Secondary Metabolite Biosynthesis" = "#4CAF50",
  "Glycolysis" = "#E5C07B",
  "Amide, Amidine, Amine, and Polyamine Degradation" = "#38BFD0",
  "Other" = "#BDBDBD", 
  "Other Biosynthesis" = "#D4A5FF"  
)

  filter(
    !is.na(MDS1),
    !is.na(MDS2),
    is.finite(MDS1),
    is.finite(MDS2),
    MDS1 != 0 | MDS2 != 0
  )

  arrange(desc(r2)) %>%
  slice(1:10)

  library(dplyr)

vectors_super <- vectors_super %>%
  mutate(
    Superclass2 = case_when(
      Superclass2 == "Carbohydrate Degradation&&Polymeric Compound Degradation" ~
        "Carbohydrate Degradation",
      TRUE ~ Superclass2
    ),
    
    color = superclass_colors[Superclass2]
  )

  geom_point(color = "grey70", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +

  geom_segment(

    xlim = c(-1.2, 1.2),
```

## Correlation clinical score - superclass2

```{r}
#| label: superclass-correlation
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###########################################
# CORRELATION CLINICAL SCORE - SUPERCLASS #
###########################################

df_corr <- superclass_matrix_cs

df_corr <- df_corr %>%
  mutate(clinical_score = as.numeric(as.character(clinical_score)))

pathway_cols <- setdiff(
  colnames(df_corr),
  c("svamp_ID", "clinical_score")
)

corr_results <- map_dfr(pathway_cols, function(pw) {

  test <- cor.test(
    df_corr[[pw]],
    df_corr$clinical_score,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    pathway = pw,
    rho = test$estimate,
    pval = test$p.value
  )
})

corr_results <- corr_results %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"),
    sig = p.adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(rho)  

write_csv(corr_results, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/superclass/correlation_cs_superclass.csv")

reactable(
  corr_results,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,  
  pagination = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10
)


heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(corr_results$rho)
rownames(heatmap_mat) <- corr_results$pathway
colnames(heatmap_mat) <- "Clinical score"

sig_mat <- as.matrix(corr_results$sig)
rownames(sig_mat) <- corr_results$pathway
colnames(sig_mat) <- "Clinical score"


heatmap_cs_pathways <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  name = "Spearman r",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Spearman r",
    title_position = "topcenter",
    legend_width = unit(4, "cm")
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(
        x = x, y = y,
        width = width, height = height,
        gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1, fill = NA)
      )
    }
  }
)

pdf("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/superclass/heatmap_cs_pathways.pdf", width = 4, height = 5)

draw(heatmap_cs_pathways, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")

dev.off()
```

## Heatmap

```{r}
#| label: superclass-heatmap 
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

######################
# HEATMAP SUPERCLASS #
######################

#cross sectional and clinical score 

#CLR normalization 
clr_data <- superclass_matrix_cross

clr_data[, 2:22] <- clr(clr_data[, 2:22] + 1e-6)

#only abundance data 
heat_dataclr <- as.matrix(clr_data[, 2:22])

#get rownames from svamp_ID
rownames(heat_dataclr) <- clr_data[[1]]

heat_dataclr_t <- t(heat_dataclr)

#hierarchical clustering
row_hclustclr <- hclust(dist(heat_dataclr_t), method = "ward.D2")   #pathways
col_hclustclr <- hclust(dist(t(heat_dataclr_t)), method = "ward.D2") #samples

#hclust objects to dendrograms
row_dendclr <- as.dendrogram(row_hclustclr)
col_dendclr <- as.dendrogram(col_hclustclr)

#clusters (adjust for how many color groups)
k_row <- 4
k_col <- 3

#colors for each cluster
row_colors <- brewer.pal(k_row, "Pastel1")
col_colors <- brewer.pal(k_col, "Pastel2")

#colors for dendrites
row_dend_colored <- color_branches(row_dendclr, k = k_row, col = row_colors)
col_dend_colored <- color_branches(col_dendclr, k = k_col, col = col_colors)

#extract group column 
sample_groups <- clr_data$group_cross
names(sample_groups) <- colnames(heat_dataclr_t)

#color for each group
group_levels <- unique(sample_groups)
group_colors <- my_colors
names(group_colors) <- group_levels

#bar above heatmap - clinical score
clr_data_cs <- clr_data %>%
left_join(superclass_matrix_cs %>% 
      select(svamp_ID, clinical_score),
    by = "svamp_ID")

clinical_score_fac <- clr_data_cs %>%
  dplyr::select(svamp_ID, clinical_score) %>%
  filter(svamp_ID %in% colnames(heat_dataclr_t)) %>%
  arrange(match(svamp_ID, colnames(heat_dataclr_t))) %>%
  pull(clinical_score) %>%
  factor(levels = 0:5, ordered = TRUE)

score_colors <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(6, "YlOrRd"),
  levels(clinical_score_fac)
)

#bar above heatmap
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = sample_groups,
  ClinicalScore = clinical_score_fac,
  col = list(
    Group = group_colors,
    ClinicalScore = score_colors
  ),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(title = "Sample Group"),
    ClinicalScore = list(title = "Clinical score (0–5)")
  )
)

heatmap_clr <- Heatmap(
  heat_dataclr_t,
  name = "clr(Pathways abundance)",
  col = colorRamp2(
    c(min(heat_dataclr_t), 0, max(heat_dataclr_t)),
    c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42") 
  ),
  cluster_rows = row_dend_colored,    
  cluster_columns = col_dend_colored,  
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")),
  show_heatmap_legend = TRUE, 
  top_annotation = col_ha
)

heatmap_clr

#ordered by clinical score 
#order columns by clinical score
col_order <- order(as.numeric(as.character(clinical_score_fac)))
heat_dataclr_t_ordered <- heat_dataclr_t[, col_order]

#reorder annotation accordingly
sample_groups_ordered <- sample_groups[col_order]
clinical_score_fac_ordered <- clinical_score_fac[col_order]

col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = sample_groups_ordered,
  ClinicalScore = clinical_score_fac_ordered,
  col = list(
    Group = group_colors,
    ClinicalScore = score_colors
  ),
   show_legend = FALSE
)


heatmap_clr <- Heatmap(
  heat_dataclr_t_ordered,
  name = "clr(Abundance)",
  col = colorRamp2(
    c(min(heat_dataclr_t_ordered), 0, max(heat_dataclr_t_ordered)),
    c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")
  ),
  cluster_rows = row_dend_colored,   
  cluster_columns = FALSE,           
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 1),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")),
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  top_annotation = col_ha, 
    row_names_max_width = unit(16, "cm")
)

png("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/superclass/Heatmap_cross-sectional_by_clinical_score_superclass.png", width = 5000, height = 8000, res = 300)  

plot(heatmap_clr)

dev.off() 


```

## Color aldex2 volcano plot by superclass

Differential abundance analysis volcano plot comparing Control and RVVCpos groups

```{r}
#| label: superclass-rvvccontrol-volcano 
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#############################################
# VOLCANO PLOT SUPERCLASS RVVCPOS - CONTROL #
#############################################

pathway_levels <- unique(x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross$Pathway)
pathway_count <- length(pathway_levels)

color_palette_volcano <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(pathway_count), pathway_levels)

significant_pathway_difabu <- x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross %>%
  filter(abs(diff.btw) > 1 & wi.ep < 0.05)

significant_pathway <- significant_pathway_difabu$Pathway 

#define cutoffs
fc_cutoff <- 1
p_cutoff <- 0.05

#is the species significant or not 
x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross <- x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      diff.btw > fc_cutoff & wi.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Up",
      diff.btw < -fc_cutoff & wi.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "Non-significant")
  )

#colors
volcano_colors <- c(
  "Up" = "hotpink",          #pink
  "Down" = "#2166ac",        # blue
  "Non-significant" = "gray70"
)

#labels in figure 
sig_species <- x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross %>%
  filter(significance != "Non-significant") %>%
  mutate(
    pretty_label = paste0(
      "italic('",
      gsub("_", " ", sub("^s__", "", Pathway)),
      "')"
    )
  )

#volcano plot with cutoffs (significance and fold change)
volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR <- ggplot(x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross,
                       aes(x = diff.btw, y = -log10(wi.ep), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = sig_species,
    aes(label = pretty_label),
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
    title = "Volcano Plot: RVVCcul.pos vs CTRLcul.neg"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

#plot(volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR)

ggsave(plot = volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/volcano_RVVCculposCTRLculneg_beforeFDR_individual_pathways.png", bg = "white", width = 12, height = 10)


#pathways colored by superclass2 
#map pathways to Superclass2
pathway_superclass_map <- FM_data %>%
  mutate(
    Pathway = paste(pathway_id, Pathway, sep = ": ")
  ) %>%
  distinct(Pathway, Superclass2)

x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross <- x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("Superclass2", "volcano_group"))) %>%
  left_join(pathway_superclass_map, by = "Pathway") %>%
  mutate(
    volcano_group = ifelse(
      significance == "Non-significant",
      "Non-significant",
      Superclass2
    )
  )


base_cols_extended <- c(
  "Nucleoside and Nucleotide Biosynthesis" = "#8FA6D6",  # blue

  "Glycolysis" = "#E5C07B",  # beige/gold

  # added groups

volcano_superclass_colors <- c(

sig_pathway <- x_all_Control_RVVCpos_cross %>%
```

## Data sets

```{r}
#| label: superclass-rvvccontrol-dataset
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

############
# DATASETS #
############

superclass_matrix <- FM_data %>%

  dplyr::select(
    Pathway,
    Superclass2,
    where(is.numeric)
  ) %>%

  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),
    names_to = "svamp_ID",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%

  group_by(svamp_ID, Superclass2) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  #normalize each sample to 100%
  group_by(svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    abundance = abundance / sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Superclass2,
    values_from = abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  )


write_csv(superclass_matrix, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/Pathway_abudance_superclass_level.csv")

#data set for cross-sectional data 
superclass_matrix_cross <- superclass_matrix %>%
  left_join(
    relative_path_cross %>%
      distinct(svamp_ID, group_cross),
    by = "svamp_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "Control")) %>%
  mutate(
    group_cross = factor(
      group_cross,
      levels = c("RVVCpos", "Control")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S10", "S15"))

#data set for clinical score data 
clinical_meta <- ra_samplerows_cross_cs %>%
  distinct(
    svamp_ID,
    clinical_score = `Clinical score (0-5)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    clinical_score = factor(
      clinical_score,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
    )
  )

superclass_matrix_cs <- superclass_matrix %>%
  left_join(
    ra_samplerows_cross_cs %>%
      distinct(
        svamp_ID,
        group_cross,
        clinical_score = `Clinical score (0-5)`
      ),
    by = "svamp_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(clinical_score)) %>%
  filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S10", "S15"))
```

```{r}
)

  xlim(-1, 1.2) +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  geom_point(size=8, aes(color=group_cross), alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = group_cross, color = group_cross), 
               type = "t",        # statistical ellipse based on multivariate t-distribution
               level = 0.95,      # 95% confidence interval
               linetype = 1,      # dashed line
               linewidth = 1) +
  #geom_jitter(aes(color = group_assigned), size = 8, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.05, height = 0.05) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("MDS Bray") +
  scale_colour_manual(
  values = my_colors,
  breaks = c("RVVCpos", "Control"),
  labels = c(
    expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
  )
) +
  #scale_x_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +

  theme(

    legend.position = "right"
  )

  geom_segment(
    data = vectors_super,
    aes(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      xend = MDS1,
      yend = MDS2,
      color = Superclass2
    ),
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.25, "cm")
    ),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = superclass_colors
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-1.2, 1.2),
    ylim = c(-1.2, 1.2),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

## Permanova

At individual pathway level comparing RVVCcul.pos VS CTRLcul.neg and looking at clinical score as an ordinal value only in the RVVC samples.

```{r}
#| label: superclass-rvvccontrol-permanova
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#############
# PERMANOVA #
#############

#cross sectional 
merged_relative_path_metadata_cross_comparison <- merged_relative_path_metadata_cross %>%
filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "Control"))

vegan::adonis2(merged_relative_path_metadata_cross_comparison[, 2:115]~group_cross, data = merged_relative_path_metadata_cross_comparison, na.action = na.omit, permutations = 999,method="bray") #0.146


#clinical score 
merged_relative_path_metadata_cross_comparison_cs <- merged_relative_path_metadata_cross %>%
filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg"))

vegan::adonis2(
  merged_relative_path_metadata_cross_comparison_cs[, 2:115] ~ `Clinical score (0-5)`,
  data = merged_relative_path_metadata_cross_comparison_cs,
  method = "bray",
  permutations = 999,
  na.action = na.omit
) #0.044





#Heterogeneity 

#clinical score 
merged_cs <- merged_relative_path_metadata_cross %>%
  filter(
    group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg"),
    !is.na(`Clinical score (0-5)`)
  )

bray_cs <- vegdist(
  merged_cs[, 2:115],
  method = "bray"
)

bd_cs <- betadisper(
  bray_cs,
  group = factor(merged_cs$`Clinical score (0-5)`)
)

anova(bd_cs)


```

## Statistics on superclasses of interest

```{r}
#| label: superclass-rvvccontrol-statistics 
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#################################
# BASIC STATISTICS SUPERCLASSES #
#################################

pathway_long <- superclass_matrix_cross %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(svamp_ID, group_cross),
    names_to = "pathway",
    values_to = "abundance"
  )

wilcox_results <- pathway_long %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  wilcox_test(abundance ~ group_cross) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  arrange(p.adj)

reactable(
  wilcox_results,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  pagination = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10
)

sig_pathways <- wilcox_results %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) #none 

write_csv(wilcox_results, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/cross_wilc.csv")

#clinical score 
pathway_long <- superclass_matrix_cs %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(svamp_ID, clinical_score, group_cross),
    names_to = "pathway",
    values_to = "abundance"
  )

kw_results <- pathway_long %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  kruskal_test(abundance ~ clinical_score) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  arrange(p.adj)

reactable(
  kw_results,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,  
  pagination = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10
)


sig_pathways <- kw_results %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) #none 

write_csv(kw_results, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/clinical_score_kw.csv")


#CLR transformation 

#metadata columns
meta_cols <- c("svamp_ID", "group_cross")

#pathway abundance columns
pathway_cols <- setdiff(
  colnames(superclass_matrix_cross),
  meta_cols
)

#extract pathway abundances
pathway_data <- superclass_matrix_cross[, pathway_cols]

#add pseudocount
pathway_pc <- pathway_data + 1e-6

#CLR transform
pathway_clr <- as.data.frame(
  clr(pathway_pc)
)

#put CLR values back together with metadata
superclass_matrix_cross_clr <- bind_cols(
  superclass_matrix_cross %>%
    select(all_of(meta_cols)),
  pathway_clr
)

pathway_long_clr <- superclass_matrix_cross_clr %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(svamp_ID, group_cross),
    names_to = "pathway",
    values_to = "CLR_abundance"
  )

wilcox_results_clr <- pathway_long_clr %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  wilcox_test(
    CLR_abundance ~ group_cross
  ) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  arrange(p.adj)

reactable(
  wilcox_results_clr,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  pagination = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10
)

sig_pathways_clr <- wilcox_results_clr %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05)

write_csv(
  wilcox_results_clr,
  "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/cross_wilc_CLR.csv"
)

#Clinical score CLR

    label = "p.signif",
    size = 6,
    bracket.size = 0,
    tip.length = 0,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ pathway,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("RVVCpos", "Control"),
    labels = group_labels
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 14
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "CLR abundance"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  )

plot(pathway_violin)

ggsave(
  plot = pathway_violin,
  "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/pathway_violin_CLR.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## Correlation clinical score - superclasses

```{r}
#| label: superclass-rvvc-correlation 
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#########################################
# CORRELATION CLINICAL SCORE SUPERCLASS #
#########################################

df_corr <- superclass_matrix_cs

df_corr <- df_corr %>%
  mutate(
    clinical_score = as.numeric(as.character(clinical_score))
  )

pathway_cols <- setdiff(
  colnames(df_corr),
  c("svamp_ID", "clinical_score")
)

pathway_cols <- pathway_cols[-22]

corr_results <- map_dfr(pathway_cols, function(pw) {

  test <- cor.test(
    df_corr[[pw]],
    df_corr$clinical_score,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    pathway = pw,
    rho = test$estimate,
    pval = test$p.value
  )
})

corr_results <- corr_results %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"),
    sig = p.adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(rho)   

write_csv(corr_results, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/correlation_cs_superclass.csv")

reactable(
  corr_results,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,  
  pagination = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10
)


heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(corr_results$rho)
rownames(heatmap_mat) <- corr_results$pathway
colnames(heatmap_mat) <- "Clinical score"

sig_mat <- as.matrix(corr_results$sig)
rownames(sig_mat) <- corr_results$pathway
colnames(sig_mat) <- "Clinical score"


heatmap_cs_pathways <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  name = "Spearman r",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Spearman r",
    title_position = "topcenter",
    legend_width = unit(4, "cm")
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(
        x = x, y = y,
        width = width, height = height,
        gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1, fill = NA)
      )
    }
  }
)

pdf("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/heatmap_cs_pathways.png",
    width = 4, height = 5)

draw(
  heatmap_cs_pathways,
  heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
  padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm")
)

dev.off()


#CLR transformed 

df_corr <- superclass_matrix_cs %>%
  mutate(
    clinical_score = as.numeric(as.character(clinical_score))
  )

superclass_data <- df_corr %>%
  select(
    -svamp_ID,
    -group_cross,
    -clinical_score
  )

superclass_pc <- superclass_data + 1e-6

superclass_clr <- as.data.frame(
  clr(superclass_pc)
)

superclass_clr <- bind_cols(
  df_corr %>%
    select(svamp_ID, group_cross, clinical_score),
  superclass_clr
)

pathway_cols <- setdiff(
  colnames(superclass_clr),
  c("svamp_ID", "group_cross", "clinical_score")
)

corr_results <- map_dfr(pathway_cols, function(pw) {

  test <- cor.test(
    superclass_clr[[pw]],
    superclass_clr$clinical_score,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    pathway = pw,
    rho = unname(test$estimate),
    pval = test$p.value
  )
})

corr_results <- corr_results %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"),
    sig = p.adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(rho)

corr_results

write_csv(corr_results, "~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/correlation_cs_superclass_CLR.csv")


reactable(
  corr_results,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,  
  pagination = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10
)  

heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(corr_results$rho)

rownames(heatmap_mat) <- corr_results$pathway
colnames(heatmap_mat) <- "Clinical score"


sig_mat <- as.matrix(corr_results$sig)

rownames(sig_mat) <- corr_results$pathway
colnames(sig_mat) <- "Clinical score"

heatmap_cs_superclass_clr <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat,

  name = "Spearman r",

  col = colorRamp2(
    c(-1, 0, 1),
    c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")
  ),

  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,

  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Spearman r",
    title_position = "topcenter",
    legend_width = unit(4, "cm")
  ),

  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {

    if (!is.na(sig_mat[i, j]) && sig_mat[i, j]) {

      grid.rect(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        width = width,
        height = height,
        gp = gpar(
          col = "black",
          lwd = 1,
          fill = NA
        )
      )
    }
  }
)

draw(
  heatmap_cs_superclass_clr,
  heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
  padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm")
)


pdf("~/R_work/Swabs_functional/output/comparison/heatmap_cs_pathways_CLR.pdf",
    width = 4, height = 5)

draw(
  heatmap_cs_superclass_clr,
  heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
  padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm")
)

dev.off()
```
